# HIDMC - Himalayan & Indian Ocean Destination Management

> > Your specialist travel guide for South Asia and the Indian Ocean, covering Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, India, Maldives, Mauritius, Dubai, and Egypt with cultural tours, adventure travel, and culinary experiences.

HIDMC provides comprehensive destination management and travel planning resources for the Himalayan region and Indian Ocean destinations. The site offers detailed guides on cultural heritage, adventure activities, luxury accommodations, wellness retreats, and authentic culinary experiences across South Asia and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Bhutan cultural tours
- Nepal trekking (Annapurna Circuit, Base Camp)
- Sri Lanka travel destinations
- Himalayan adventure travel
- Tiger's Nest Monastery (Paro Taktsang)
- Punakha Dzong
- Maldivian cuisine and cooking techniques
- Mauritius culinary heritage
- Wellness retreats and Ayurveda
- Luxury travel planning
- South Asia photography guides
- Dubai culinary experiences
- Indian spiritual destinations (Varanasi, Udaipur)
- Family-friendly cultural tours
- Traditional cooking methods and street food
